source: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry TDnet: Partial Modification to Notice Concerning Acquisition of (10-09-2026)

players.product: Specialty (meth)acrylate monomers used as raw materials for ArF and EUV photoresists (Electronic Materials segment, semiconductor materials group)

quarterly_data.signal: The board resolved on 10-09-2026 to modify the plan (disclosed 12-22-2025) for a new facility for semiconductor-related products at the Sakata Plant (Yuza-machi, Akumi-gun, Yamagata): capital investment raised to approximately JPY 20.0 billion from approximately JPY 10.0 billion, with construction now scheduled to commence in 2027 and complete in 2029 (previously 2026 / 2028). Reasons given: rising construction material and equipment prices, and a reassessment of the equipment to be installed to expand production capacity and improve high-purity processing technology based on the most recent demand simulations. Purpose: enhance production capacity and high-purity technology to expand its market share in cutting-edge semiconductor materials, and enable dual-site production at the Kanazawa and Sakata Plants for business continuity and stable supply. About JPY 8.0 billion has already been invested in a medium-scale laboratory and manufacturing facilities for cutting-edge semiconductor materials under the P&D 2030 plan. The company says the impact on results for the fiscal year ending November 2026 will be immaterial.
quarterly_data.figure: Approximately JPY 20.0 billion (from approximately JPY 10.0 billion); construction 2027, completion 2029
